title: FLANNEL: Focal Loss Based Neural Network Ensemble for COVID-19 Detection
summary: FLANNEL classified COVID-19 in a four-class chest X-ray dataset. The learned ensemble improved on the study baselines in cross-validation, with relatively few COVID-19 images available.
ai_technology: Five CNN base learners feed a learned weighted ensemble; focal loss handles class imbalance.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Five-fold testing covered 5,508 radiographs from 2,874 patients, including 100 COVID-19 images.
evidence.unknown: The study did not report an external clinical cohort or a prospective test of patient benefit.
evidence.ai_role: Five CNN base learners feed a learned weighted ensemble; focal loss handles class imbalance.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
